resources.string: Ikhodi ye-SandFly Pro ingavuselelwa ngekhadi qho ngenyanga noma qho ngonyaka. Hamba ku-Amasethingi, SandFly Pro bese ukhetha “Vula ukuvuselela okuzenzakalelayo”. Isikrini se-SandFly Pro sibe sesibonisa usuku lokuvuselela. Ukuze ukhansele ukuvuselela okuzenzakalelayo noma ushintshe ikhadi, khetha “Phatha okubhalisiwe” kusikrini esifanayo. I-SandFly ithumela isaziso ngaphambi kokuvuselela noma usuku lokuphela, nalapho inkokhelo ihluleka.

I-SandFly ithatha isithombe ngekhamera iso sichaze, futhi ungabuza imibuzo eyengeziwe ngesithombe. Ukuze usisebenzise, nikeza “Thatha isithombe uchaze” ku-Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Izincazelo zezithombe nezesikrini.
Ukubona bukhoma kunemodi ye-“Izinga lokukhanya”, ekhuluma ukuthi inzwa yokukhanya ikala ukukhanya okungakanani, njenge-“Ukukhanya okuncane” noma “Ukukhanya okukhulu”.

I-Whisper nemodeli esedivayisini kungahlala enkumbulweni imizuzu emi-5, eyi-15 noma engama-30 ngemva kokusetshenziswa, ukuze ukubona okulandelayo kuqale ngokushesha. Hamba ku-Amasethingi, Ukuthayipha, Ukubhalisa ngezwi noma ku-Amasethingi, Izincazelo zezithombe nezesikrini bese ukhetha “Gcina amamodeli okubona alayishiwe”.

I-SandFly ingabonisa ama-app akamuva njengohlu, esikhundleni sokubuka konke kwesistimu. Hamba ku-Amasethingi, Buka konke bese uvula “Sebenzisa ukubuka konke kwe-SandFly”. Idinga i-Shizuku. Umyalo othi “Buka konke”, ukuthinta kokuzulazula nenkinobho Yakamuva kuvula uhlu. Thepha kabili i-app ukuze ushintshele kuyo. Izenzo ze-app yilezi: Vala, Isikrini esihlukanisiwe nolwazi lwe-app. Ukubeka i-app yakamuva ekugcineni, vula “I-app yakamuva ngezansi”. Ukuze ubonise ama-app njengegridi, khetha “Amakholomu”.

Uma “Sebenzisa ukubuka konke kwe-SandFly” kuvuliwe, bamba i-Alt bese ucindezela i-Tab ekhibhodini ebonakalayo ukuze uhambe phakathi kwama-app akamuva. I-SandFly ikhuluma i-app ngayinye. Khulula i-Alt ukuze ushintshele ku-app, noma ucindezele i-Escape ukuze uhlale ku-app yamanje.

Umyalo othi “I-app edlule” ushintshela ku-app esetshenziswe ngaphambi kwe-app esesikrinini. Ukusebenzisa futhi umyalo othi “Buka konke” ngenkathi ukubuka konke kwe-SandFly kuvuliwe kwenza into efanayo. Umyalo ukhona ku-Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Izenzo zesistimu.

“Ukubuka konke kwesistimu” kuvula ukubuka konke kwesistimu, nalapho “Sebenzisa ukubuka konke kwe-SandFly” kuvuliwe. “Thatha isithombe-skrini” kuthatha isithombe-skrini. Yomibili imiyalo ikhona ku-Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Izenzo zesistimu.

Imenyu ethi “Isikrini esihlukanisiwe” iya kusihlukanisi iphinde isebenzise izenzo zesihlukanisi. Khetha “Isikrini esihlukanisiwe” kumenyu ye-SandFly, noma unikeze umyalo othi “Isikrini esihlukanisiwe” ku-Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Izenzo zesistimu. Ukuze uvule i-app kusikrini esihlukanisiwe, khetha “Vula kusikrini esihlukanisiwe” ezenzweni zesithonjana se-app esikrinini sasekhaya, swayipha ngeminwe emithathu uye phezulu kusiqalisi sama-app se-braille, noma swayipha ngeminwe emithathu uye phansi kusiqalisi sama-app sokubhala ngesandla. Idinga i-Shizuku.

Umyalo ngamunye wento nesikhiye semodi yokuphequlula manje kusebenza kuma-app kanye nasekhasini lewebhu, okuhlanganisa izinkinobho, amabhokisi okuthikha, izinhlu, amatafula, izimpawu zendawo nezihloko zazo zonke izinga. I-SandFly iskrola ukuze ifinyelele entweni elandelayo. Ama-app awabikeli amazinga ezihloko noma izixhumanisi ezivakashelwe, ngakho izinga ngalinye lezihloko lidlula kuzo zonke izihloko, futhi zonke izixhumanisi ku-app zibalwa njengezingavakashelwe.

Isilawuli sokufunda Imisho sidlula embhalweni umusho owodwa ngesikhathi. Swayipha uye phansi ukuze uthole umusho olandelayo naphezulu ukuze uthole odlule. Ukuze wengeze isilawuli sokufunda, hamba ku-Amasethingi, Izilawuli zokufunda.

Ungenza izinhlu ezibizwa ngegama zezilawuli zokufunda, ngasinye sinemiyalo yaso ethi Okulandelayo nethi Okudlule. Hamba ku-Amasethingi, Izilawuli zokufunda, Uhlu lwezilawuli zokufunda bese ukhetha “Engeza uhlu”. Imiyalo ikhona ku-Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Uhlu lwezilawuli zokufunda.

Imenyu yokuhlela inalokhu: Umlando webhodi yokunamathisela, Kopisha, Engeza kubhodi yokunamathisela, Sika, Namathisela, Khetha konke nemodi yokukhetha. Ukuze usebenzise imenyu, nikeza “Imenyu yokuhlela” ku-Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Ukuhlela umbhalo.

Isichazamazwi sezimpawu sishintsha uphawu noma ukulandelana kwezimpawu noma yikuphi lapho kuvela khona lo mbhalo ofanayo, enkulumweni nasesibonisweni se-braille. Hamba ku-Amasethingi, Inkulumo, Isichazamazwi sezimpawu noma ku-Amasethingi, I-Braille, Isichazamazwi sezimpawu bese ukhetha “Engeza okufakwa esikhundleni”.

“Impendulo yoguquko lwevolumu” kushintshela “Khuluma izinguquko zevolumu”. Hamba ku-Amasethingi, Okhiye bevolumu, Impendulo yoguquko lwevolumu bese ukhetha “Kuvaliwe”, “Ithoni”, “Inkulumo” noma “Ithoni nenkulumo”. “Inkulumo” ikhuluma uhlobo lwevolumu nezinga, njengo-“Ivolumu yemidiya isethwe ku-60 peresenti”, nalapho imidiya idlalwa.
Isikhathi sokucindezela isikhiye sevolumu isikhathi eside

Ukuze usethe isikhathi sokubamba isikhiye sevolumu ukuze kusebenze umyalo wokucindezela isikhathi eside, hamba ku-Amasethingi, Okhiye bevolumu, Isikhathi sokucindezela isikhiye sevolumu isikhathi eside. Imiyalo yesikhiye sevolumu iphinde isebenze kusibonisi esihlala sivuliwe esibonisa isikrini sokukhiya.
Ukuze ukhulume igama nohlobo lwento ngaphandle kokuma phakathi kwazo, hamba ku-Amasethingi, I-Verbosity bese uvula “Khuluma uhlobo lwento ngaphandle kokuma”.

I-SandFly idlala umsindo uma ikhibhodi esesikrinini ivuleka noma ivalwa, kuwo wonke amakhibhodi esesikrinini. Ukuze ushintshe ukuthi i-SandFly imemezela yini ukuthi ikhibhodi iboniswa noma ifihlwa, hamba ku-Amasethingi, I-Verbosity bese ukhetha “Memezela uma ikhibhodi iboniswa noma ifihlwa”.
